description: Keymind Cascade MeshCore 1.17.1.7 USA Cascade development release. 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5. 536 qualified firmware profiles across five GitHub release pages; see the exact image capability manifest. Four 256 KiB STM32WL USB Companions omit packet diagnostics to retain their filesystem. ESP32 layout changes require the matching merged USB image or an exact board and role staged migration ZIP from the utility release; app-only images cannot expand partitions.

companionWifi.name: Companion WiFi
companionWifi.description: Companion radio over trusted local Wi-Fi (TCP port 5000). First-time network setup uses the MeshCore setup access point; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.description: Telemetry node that reads and publishes only the sensors compiled for and detected on the selected board; this custom role is not a companion or repeater.

companionEthernet.name: Companion Ethernet
companionEthernet.description: Companion radio over wired Ethernet (TCP port 5000). Requires compatible Ethernet hardware and a DHCP network; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

companionFull.name: Full Companion
companionFull.description: All supported Companion transports and host-backed MOTA sending in one exact-board image. Full starts in ASCII USB mode. WiFi/BLE availability and self-update depend on the board; configure MQTT through WebConfig where included.
